name: ICS Protocol Security Analysis
description: Deep security analysis of industrial communication protocols. Covers protocol-level vulnerability assessment of Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA/DA, EtherNet/IP (CIP), PROFINET, BACnet, IEC 61850, and HART. Includes traffic analysis, command injection testing, authentication bypass, and replay attack assessment.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to ICS protocol security analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands common ICS protocols and their inherent security limitations
evidence: Can describe major ICS protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, EtherNet/IP) and their typical use
Aware that many legacy ICS protocols lack authentication and encryption
Understands why protocol testing must be performed with extreme caution in live environments

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can capture and analyze ICS protocol traffic under supervision
evidence: Captures and decodes ICS protocol traffic using Wireshark or protocol-specific tools
Identifies unencrypted commands and unauthenticated operations in captured traffic
Performs basic protocol interaction in lab environments with guidance
Documents protocol traffic analysis findings with appropriate context for OT safety review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently analyzes ICS protocol security and identifies exploitable weaknesses
evidence: Performs protocol-level vulnerability assessment across multiple ICS protocols
Tests for command injection, replay, and man-in-the-middle conditions in the lab, or against operational assets only under a process-safe profile agreed with the asset owner, including abort criteria
Evaluates OPC UA security configurations including certificate and session management
Produces protocol security analysis reports with prioritized findings and mitigations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Analyzes complex multi-protocol environments; develops custom protocol tooling; mentors others
evidence: Develops custom dissectors, fuzzers, or interaction scripts for ICS protocols, exercising fuzzers against lab or bench devices rather than operational assets
Assesses protocol security in converged IT/OT environments with multiple protocol stacks
Reviews and calibrates protocol analysis findings across the team
Evaluates protocol-level detection and monitoring capabilities

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines ICS protocol analysis practice; publishes research; shapes assessment standards
evidence: Established the lab's ICS protocol security analysis methodology
Published research on ICS protocol vulnerabilities or novel attack techniques
Deep expertise across legacy and modern industrial protocol stacks
Trains teams on ICS protocol analysis and contributes to industry guidance

assessment_methods.description: Analyze ICS protocol traffic in a lab environment: identify protocol vulnerabilities, demonstrate command injection or replay, and evaluate deployed mitigations
Review ICS protocol analysis reports for protocol coverage, attack depth, and safety-aware recommendations
